title: Full-Text Search
description: Implement full-text search on a blog_posts table. Find posts that match the query 'database performance tuning' using tsvector and tsquery. Show title, rank, and a highlighted snippet.
hints: Use to_tsvector('english', title || ' ' || body) to create the search vector
Use plainto_tsquery('english', 'database performance tuning') for the query
Use ts_rank() to order by relevance
Use ts_headline() to show highlighted matches
